title: An adoption census runs krn adopt, standards check and adopt --verify on fifteen real operator repositories
body:
Why: Fable plan 1114c #1. The pilots were test-friendly (.krn/runs/pilot/decision.md:3); of 117 operator project dirs only krn has krn.json and 54 are not git.
Outcome: a scripted census over scratch clones (no push) of about 15 operator repositories under /mnt/storage/coding (git repos, mixed stacks: TS, PHP/WordPress, Python, workspaces); a committed per-repo table (adopt exit, standards check verdict, verify gaps, test command detected); every failure becomes a fixture test in KRN or a task.
Proof: the census script reruns and reproduces the committed table; npm run fast PASS.
